claims.original_claim: OceanEmbed achieves a near-zero generalization gap (|1.8142 - 1.8126| = 0.0016 C) between reanalysis and in-situ ARGO
claims.evidence: GLORYS and ARGO represent heterogeneous observation modalities with completely distinct spatial geometries and sampling densities
claims.replacement_text: OceanEmbed yields a similar aggregate RMSE magnitude (~1.81 C) across both GLORYS reanalysis and ARGO in-situ point observations

claims.original_claim: OceanEmbed exhibits consistent generalization across reanalysis and in-situ data
claims.evidence: Simple CNN outperforms OceanEmbed by 0.86 C on ARGO and 0.77 C on GLORYS; Pointwise MLP is second
claims.replacement_text: OceanEmbed maintains a consistent error scale (~1.81 C), but currently underperforms simpler CNN and MLP baselines across both evaluation references

claims.evidence: No uncertainty estimation, conformal prediction, or calibration curves were evaluated; prediction is deterministic point estimate
claims.replacement_text: Deterministic point predictions yield an overall mean bias of -0.34 C against in-situ ARGO profiles

claims.original_claim: Comprehensive September 2020 ARGO validation across the entire month
claims.evidence: ARGO profiles were retrieved exclusively on three calendar snapshot dates: September 1, 15, and 25 (36 profiles, 497 points)
claims.replacement_text: Contemporaneous in-situ observational evaluation across three discrete snapshot dates in September 2020 (Sept 1, 15, 25; 36 profiles, 497 points)

claims.original_claim: Fully independent observational validation against ground truth
claims.evidence: ARGO is independent of model inputs, but GLORYS12V1 operationally assimilates in-situ observations; float assimilation status was unverified
claims.replacement_text: In-situ observational validation independent of model training inputs. Float assimilation status within GLORYS12V1 was not verified

claims.evidence: Simple CNN achieves lower RMSE at every single depth below 150m (CNN 0.40 C vs OceanEmbed 1.19 C at 1000m)
claims.replacement_text: While OceanEmbed resolves abyssal layers below 500m to within 0.54 C, Simple CNN achieves lower error across all depths, indicating substantial room for OceanEmbed architectural refinement

claims.original_claim: TensorRT and ONNX deployment acceleration implemented
claims.evidence: PyTorch CPU and CUDA execution are operational; TensorRT and ONNX export are planned for Phase 5
claims.replacement_text: PyTorch CPU/CUDA operational with ~367 ms/grid latency; TensorRT and ONNX export planned for production scaling

claims.original_claim: Thermocline error is caused by internal waves and non-monotonic stratification
claims.evidence: No internal wave modeling or baroclinic wave experiments were executed in this codebase
claims.replacement_text: Observed architectural performance limitation in the 75-150m depth window where vertical thermal gradients are sharpest
